title: RBI Issues Comprehensive AIFI Recovery Agent and Loan Recovery Conduct Directions from January 2027
description: RBI's Third Amendment Directions, 2026 introduce a comprehensive framework for AIFI loan recovery, recovery agencies, borrower safeguards and device-locking rules from 1 January 2027.The post RBI Issues Comprehensive AIFI Recovery Agent and Loan Recovery Conduct Directions from January 2027 appeared first on TaxGuru.
